items.title: Father Al Lewis Interview, 1972-02-21
items.q: twelve miles from Caggan was Elvus Reda, see, white passengers come down and get on the boat.

ctx.x: Fell down in there where they had the stuffed stash, not the still. And they got some routers on the bottom deck to bring that thing there, everybody was drunk on that boat because we got the cam and then come back. We bought suitcases with our clothes and went out there and loaded up, you know, big old Jimmy Jones, the first three full top ones we took that off and said it might be poison, we got the ones underneath and brought them down. We used to have some, see, twelve miles from Caggan was Elvus Reda, see,…
